Class MinHeap<T extends Comparable<T>>

java.lang.Object
assignments.datastructures.MinHeap<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of values stored
All Implemented Interfaces:
adt.PriorityQueue<T>, adt.Tree<T>, Iterable<T>
public class MinHeap<T extends Comparable<T>> extends Object implements adt.PriorityQueue<T>, adt.Tree<T>
A min-heap stored in a Vector. The smallest value is always at the root. No recursion is used.
